notes.text: The parenthetical names שרש, Sheresh, with I Chronicles 7:16. It is not translated as a root lexicon or marked as an established printing error; the vocalization is conventional, and no named edition is independently checked.
ב״ב לב: is rendered Bava Batra 32b under the colon convention. Rava bar Sharshom is supplied without an additional personal title.
